description: Calculates a lending health factor from position inputs, with no wallet or on-chain lookup required. Give it collateral (one or more assets, each with its own liquidation threshold) and the debt, and it returns the health factor, the blended threshold, the collateral drop that would trigger liquidation, and the collateral value at which liquidation begins. Optionally simulates a collateral price drop and a change in the borrowed asset's price. Formula: HF = (Σ collateral value × liquidation threshold) ÷ debt. Works for Aave, Morpho, Spark, Kamino and any protocol using the standard formula. Use this when asked: "What is my health factor if I supply 5 ETH at 80% and borrow $6,500?", "How far can ETH fall before I get liquidated?", "What happens to my HF if I add collateral or repay?", "Work out the health factor for this position".

collateral.description: Collateral legs. Pass one entry per supplied asset; each keeps its own liquidation threshold and the blended figure is derived.

liquidation_threshold_pct.description: This asset's liquidation threshold as a percentage, e.g. 80 for 80%. Not the max LTV — the threshold is the higher line where liquidation begins.

symbol.description: Optional label for this leg, e.g. "ETH" or "wBTC". Only used in the readable output.

value_usd.description: Value of this collateral asset in USD, e.g. 10000 for 5 ETH at $2,000

collateral_drop_pct.description: Optional: simulate the collateral falling by this percentage, e.g. 30 for a 30% crash.

debt_change_pct.description: Optional: simulate the borrowed asset's price moving by this percentage. Positive grows the debt and pushes HF down (borrowing a volatile asset); 0 or omitted is stablecoin debt.

debt_usd.description: Total borrowed value in USD. Zero means no debt, so no liquidation risk.

name: calculate_health_factor

blendedThresholdPct.description: Weighted liquidation threshold across all collateral legs

collateralValueUsd.description: Total collateral value across every leg

debtUsd.description: Total debt used in the calculation

dropToLiquidationPct.description: How far the collateral can fall before the health factor reaches 1.0

healthFactor.description: Health factor, or null when there is no debt — with nothing borrowed there is no liquidation point

liquidationAtCollateralValueUsd.description: Total collateral value at which liquidation begins, or null when there is no debt

riskAdjustedCollateralUsd.description: Collateral value after each leg is discounted by its own liquidation threshold

riskLevel.description: Risk tier, or null when there is no debt

simulated.description: Present only when a simulation was requested

healthFactor.description: Health factor after the simulation, null when there is no debt

liquidated.description: True if the simulated health factor is below 1.0

title: Calculate Health Factor
